map.根据出生日期计算各项法定权利义务起始年龄: Computes the ages at which legal rights and duties begin, from the date of birth
map.📖 查看「法定年龄计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Legal Age Calculator User Guide"
map.法定年龄 = 当前 − 出生日期: Legal age = today − date of birth
map.民事权利能力始于出生，胎儿享有继承权/接受赠与权: Capacity for civil rights begins at birth; a fetus has the right to inherit and to accept gifts
map.限制民事行为能力人，可以独立实施纯获利益或与其年龄智力相适应的民事法律行为: A person with limited capacity who may independently perform acts that bring pure benefit or suit their age and intelligence
map.部分犯罪负刑事责任（故意杀人、故意伤害致人重伤死亡、强奸、抢劫、贩毒、放火、爆炸: Partial criminal responsibility for intentional homicide, intentional injury causing serious injury or death, rape, robbery, drug trafficking, arson, explosion and poisoning
map.完全刑事责任年龄；可以成为劳动者；以自己劳动收入为主要生活来源的视为完全民事行为: Full criminal responsibility; may be employed; a minor whose own labour income is the main source of livelihood is treated as having full capacity; may obtain an ID card, which is also available under 16
map.成年；完全民事行为能力人；有选举权被选举权；服兵役义务: Adulthood; full capacity for civil conduct; the right to vote and stand for election; the obligation of military service
map.女20/男22法定结婚年龄: Statutory marriageable age: 20 for women and 22 for men
map.可以被选为国家主席/副主席的最低年龄: Minimum age to be elected president or vice-president
map.女55（干部）/50（工人）男60法定退休年龄（灵活就业女性55岁）: Statutory retirement age: 55 for women cadres, 50 for women workers and 60 for men, with 55 for women in flexible employment
map.故意犯罪可从轻或减轻处罚，过失犯罪应从轻减轻；不适用死刑（特别残忍手段致人死亡除: Intentional crimes may be punished leniently or more leniently and negligent crimes shall be; the death penalty does not apply except where death is caused by especially cruel means
map.核对某人是否已达成年（18 周岁）、婚龄（男 22/女 20）、刑事责任年龄等关: Check whether someone has reached majority at 18, the marriageable age of 22 for men and 20 for women, or the age of criminal responsibility.
map.计算到某一法律里程碑（如退休、完全行为能力）的剩余天数。: Count the days remaining to a legal milestone such as retirement or full capacity.
map.判断劳动者是否达到特定用工年龄限制。: Decide whether a worker meets a particular age limit for employment.
map.出生 2008-05-01，2026-05-01 满 18 周岁（完全民事行为能: Born 2008-05-01, the person turns 18 on 2026-05-01 with full capacity; a man born 2004-01-01 reaches the marriageable age of 22 in 2026.
map.已满 14 周岁不满 16 周岁对八类严重犯罪负刑责；已满 16 周岁对所有犯罪: From 14 to under 16 a person is responsible for eight serious crimes, and from 16 for all crimes; the tool flags the relevant milestones from the date of birth.
map.年龄按虚岁还是周岁？: Is age counted in nominal or completed years?
map.法律上的年龄一律按公历周岁计算，自生日次日起满一岁。: Legal age is always counted in completed years on the Gregorian calendar, adding one year from the day after the birthday.
map.十六周岁以上的未成年人，以自己的劳动收入为主要生活来源的，视为完全民事行为能力人: A minor aged 16 or over whose own labour income is the main source of livelihood is treated as having full capacity for civil conduct.
map.法定年龄计算器。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Legal Age Calculator. A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
